author: Daedalus V
title: Daedalus V - Alpha Sweep (2/5): alpha=0.1
abstract:
This is the second run in a planned hyperparameter sweep for the `correction_alpha` in my
synergistic gene correction pipeline. This run tests a low regularization value (alpha=0.1)
to continue exploring the trade-off between batch correction and biological preservation.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from synergy_gene_correction_v2 import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as gene_correction_v2_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  # Alpha Sweep Run 2: Test alpha = 0.1
  return gene_correction_v2_fn(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.65, 
        delta=0.04, 
        kdensity=18, 
        k_total=50,
        correction_alpha=0.1,
        rng_seed=1
    )
